name: Environmental Conditions
description: Room temperature, humidity, and input voltage readings recorded before/after calibration. Present in nearly all LK worksheets (Section B).
evidence_source: LK Blood Pressure Monitor.pdf p1; LK Ventilator Transport.pdf p1; LK Sterilisator.pdf p1 (representative sample; pattern repeats across ~28 of 30 LK documents)

name: Electrical Safety
description: Standard electrical safety test block (earth resistance, insulation resistance, leakage currents) per IEC 62353-style testing. Present in nearly all LK worksheets (Section D).
evidence_source: LK Blood Pressure Monitor.pdf p2; LK Ventilator Transport.pdf p2; LK Sterilisator.pdf p2 (representative sample; pattern repeats across ~26 of 30 LK documents)

name: Non-Invasive Blood Pressure
description: Blood pressure measurement accuracy (systolic/diastolic/mean).
evidence_source: LK Blood Pressure Monitor.pdf p2; LK Bed Side Monitor.pdf (Kalibrasi NIBP)

name: Vital Signs Monitoring
description: Heart rate, respiration rate, and SpO2 accuracy as measured on patient monitors.
evidence_source: LK Bed Side Monitor.pdf (Kalibrasi Heart Rate; Kalibrasi Respirasi; Kalibrasi Saturasi Oxygen); LK Pulse Oxymeter.pdf (Kalibrasi Heart Rate; Kalibrasi Saturasi Oxygen)

name: ECG Performance
description: Electrocardiograph signal accuracy: amplitude, recording speed, heart rate, waveform tests.
evidence_source: LK Electrocardiograph.pdf (Pengukuran Amplitudo; Laju Rekaman; Kalibrasi Detak Jantung; Uji Sinyal Sinusoida; Uji Sinyal EKG Normal)

name: NIBP Cuff/Manometer Leak & Deflation
description: Sphygmomanometer-specific pneumatic tests: leak test, rapid deflation rate, pressure accuracy.
evidence_source: LK Sphygmomanometer.pdf (Uji kebocoran; Laju buang cepat; Pengukuran akurasi tekanan)

name: Ventilation Performance
description: Ventilator-specific respiratory mechanics: tidal/minute volume, respiration rate, I:E ratio, inspiratory/expiratory time, PEEP, peak inspiratory pressure, FiO2.
evidence_source: LK Ventilator Transport.pdf p2-4 (9 numbered sub-tests)

name: Resuscitator Pressure
description: Maximum pressure and pressure accuracy for manual/mechanical resuscitators (Cardiac/Pulmonary/Neopuff).
evidence_source: LK Resusitator Paru dan Neopuff.pdf (nilai tekanan maksimum; Kalibrasi akurasi tekanan resuscitator)

name: Sterilization Chamber Temperature
description: Chamber temperature, sterilization temperature, and sterilization time for autoclaves/dry sterilizers/ovens.
evidence_source: LK Autoclave.pdf (Suhu Chamber; Suhu Sterilisasi; Waktu Sterilisasi); LK Sterilisator.pdf p2 (multi-point temp table); LK Oven.pdf (same multi-point temp table pattern)

name: Cold Storage Temperature Uniformity
description: Multi-point temperature uniformity inside refrigerators/freezers/cold-chain storage.
evidence_source: LK Blood Bank Refrigerator.pdf p2 (Setting suhu 2-8C
column5: T1-T9 multi-point); LK Medical Refrigerator.pdf p2; LK Medical Freezer.pdf p2 (Setting suhu -5 s.d. -150C); LK Cold Chain

name: Incubator Environment
description: Baby incubator air temperature calibration, overshoot temperature, temperature recovery time, mattress temperature, air velocity, noise level, and skin temperature sensor calibration.
evidence_source: LK Baby Incubator.pdf (Kalibrasi Suhu Udara; Overshot Temperature/Waktu Pemulihan/Suhu Matras/Kecepatan Udara/Kebisingan; Kalibrasi Sensor Temperature Kulit)

name: Warmer Surface Temperature
description: Infant/radiant warmer mattress surface maximum temperature and general temperature calibration.
evidence_source: LK Infant Warmer.pdf (Kalibrasi suhu maksimum pada permukaan matras; Kalibrasi suhu)

name: Humidifier Temperature
description: Humidifier temperature accuracy and maximum temperature.
evidence_source: LK Humidifier.pdf (Akurasi Suhu; Suhu Maksimum)

name: Vacuum / Suction Performance
description: Vacuum gauge accuracy, maximum vacuum level, and time-to-maximum-vacuum for suction/breast pump devices.
evidence_source: LK Suction Pump.pdf (Akurasi Vacuum Gauge; Maximum Vacuum; Waktu Yang Dibutuhkan Saat Daya Hisap Maksimum)

name: Rotational Speed & Timing
description: Centrifuge rotation speed and rotation time accuracy.
evidence_source: LK Centrifuge.pdf (Kalibrasi Kecepatan Putar; Kalibrasi Waktu Putar)

name: Infusion Flow Performance
description: Infusion/syringe pump occlusion test and flow rate calibration.
evidence_source: LK Infusion Pump.pdf (Pengujian Occlusion/Pemampatan; Kalibrasi Laju aliran); LK Syringe Pump.pdf (same)

name: Optical Magnification
description: Microscope objective magnification accuracy at multiple magnification levels and magnification ratio.
evidence_source: LK Mikroskop Laboratorium.pdf (Pembesaran Objektif 4x; Pembesaran Objektif 10x; Nilai Ratio Pembesaran)

name: Gas Flow Rate
description: Gas flow rate accuracy for flow meters, nebulizer compressors, and oxygen concentrators.
evidence_source: LK Flow Meter.pdf (Flow/Laju aliran); LK Nebulizer Compressor.pdf (Laju aliran gas); LK Nebulizer Ultrasonic.pdf (Laju aliran gas); LK Oksigen Concentrator.pdf (Laju aliran gas flowmeter)

name: Oxygen Concentration
description: Output oxygen concentration accuracy for oxygen concentrators.
evidence_source: LK Oksigen Concentrator.pdf (Konsentrasi Oksigen)

name: Ultrasound Imaging Performance
description: Ultrasonograph (USG) image quality tests: dead zone, axial/lateral resolution, penetration depth, vertical/horizontal distance calibration.
evidence_source: LK Ultrasonograph (USG).pdf (Pengujian Dead Zone; Pengujian Axial dan Lateral Resolution; Pengujian Penetrasi Kedalaman; Kalibrasi Jarak Vertikal; Kalibrasi Jarak Horizontal)

name: Mass Weighing Performance
description: Scale repeatability and deviation-from-nominal testing for infant/adult weighing scales.
evidence_source: LK Timbangan Bayi.pdf (Kalibrasi Daya Ulang Pembacaan; Penyimpangan Dari Nilai Nominal); LK Timbangan Dewasa.pdf (same)
